mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy that reduces the discount rate for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is declining, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 4.5% indicates deteriorating labor market conditions, which signal a weakening economy and lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 4.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts fall below 1300 thousand units and unemployment rate exceeds 4.0%, the combined weakness in the housing sector and labor market signals a deepening economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when both HOUST < 1300 and UNRATE > 4.0%, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In the post-recession recovery regime, a retail sales level below 705,000 million indicates weak consumer demand, which is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods within the post-recession recovery regime when RSAFS < 705000, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 100 (index) indicates a contraction in the manufacturing sector, which signals reduced economic activity and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 100, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the consumer price index above 310 signals accelerating inflation, which may prompt the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 310, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts below 1300 thousand units indicates weakening residential demand, which signals a deteriorating housing market and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST < 1300, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in total nonfarm payrolls below 157,000 thousand indicates a weakening labor market, which signals reduced consumer spending and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS < 157000, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
